facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2026-2029 budget guidelines, circulated 29 August 2025, carry a Section Four of instructions to Regional Coordinating Councils and Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies with a part on GIFMIS, which the page's summary note says requires them to process all financial transactions through that national system; this is an instruction, with no count of assemblies doing so and no connection described.
facts.system: Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System (GIFMIS)

systems.system: Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System (GIFMIS)
systems.tiers: Regional Coordinating Councils and Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies, by instruction of the budget guidelines

note: The captured body is an excerpt: Section Four appears only in the table of contents, and the GIFMIS mandate is stated in the page's own summary note, not in the captured text. The fact is a mandate, not a report of use; the parent should weigh it accordingly.
